title: Food We Love
source_credit: Original WorldVoice A1 learning dialogue · text-only; no voice recording has been published.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: I'm hungry, Adam. Are you hungry too?
dialogue.translation_ar: أنا جائعة يا آدم. هل أنت جائع أيضًا؟

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Yes, Lina. It's time for lunch.
dialogue.translation_ar: نعم يا لينا. حان وقت الغداء.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: What do you want to eat?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: I want rice and chicken.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: That sounds good. I like fish.
dialogue.translation_ar: يبدو ذلك جيدًا. أنا أحب السمك.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Do you eat fish every week?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: No, I eat fish once or twice a month.
dialogue.translation_ar: لا، أتناول السمك مرة أو مرتين في الشهر.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: What do you have for breakfast?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: I usually eat eggs, bread, and fruit.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: What fruit do you like?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: I like apples and bananas.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: I love oranges. They are sweet.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Do you cook at home?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: Sometimes. I make simple vegetable soup.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Is the soup difficult to make?

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: No. I cut vegetables and add water.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: I want to learn to cook too.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: We can make dinner together tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.text: Great! I can bring some fresh vegetables.
dialogue.translation_ar: رائع! يمكنني إحضار بعض الخضراوات الطازجة.

dialogue.speaker: Adam
dialogue.text: And I will bring the bread.

questions.question: What does Adam want for lunch?
What does Lina usually eat for breakfast?
